app.title: Sumeragi Native+
home.hero_subtitle: Direct x86-64 execution, native PS4 system contracts & Vulkan translation.
home.game_exited_code: Game exited with code {code}. See the log.
home.card_game_not_ready: Will prepare image on first launch
game_files.title: Game Installation & Files
game_files.subtitle: Configure your legal PS4 game dump containing eboot.bin, sce_sys, and sce_module.
game_files.path_hint: Select the folder containing eboot.bin (e.g., game\ or your external dump folder).
game_files.image_ready: Game image is ready in out\. Hash verified.
game_files.image_not_ready: Game image has not been prepared yet. It will be built automatically upon first launch (~1 minute).
game_files.reprepare_confirm_msg: Delete the current prepared image in out\ and regenerate from the base dump?
updates.title: Game Updates
updates.subtitle: Mount extracted PS4 game update folders (e.g. v1.02) without modifying the original dump.
updates.path_hint: Select the extracted update directory containing eboot.bin and updated assets.
updates.overlay_desc: When an update is active, Sumeragi Native+ creates a virtual overlay view during launch. Updated files take precedence, while untouched files fall back to the base game. Both folders remain completely read-only.
updates.status_active: Update folder active. Game will launch as v{version}.
updates.status_none: No update configured. Game will launch as base v{version}.
dlc.title: Add-on Content (DLC)
dlc.subtitle: Automatically discover and mount local add-on costumes, weapons, and BGM packages.
dlc.empty_state_desc: Place extracted DLC folders into dlc\CUSA01159\ or browse to your custom DLC root folder. Each subfolder will be mounted into virtual /addcont0, /addcont1... at runtime.
trophies.title: Trophies
trophies.subtitle: Offline PS4 trophy system with real-time in-game notifications (F8 / R3+R2).
trophies.reset_confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to reset all trophy progress?
A backup will be saved to user/trophies.dat.bak before clearing.
trophies.reset_success_msg:
Trophy progress has been reset. Backup created:
{path}
trophies.no_package: No trophy package (trophy00.trp) found in game dump.
controls.title: Controller Configuration & Button Remapping
controls.subtitle: Calibrate hardware DirectInput gamepads and remap in-game logical actions.
controls.hw_section_desc: For generic controllers where buttons or analog axes are not natively recognized by Windows/SDL.
controls.hw_status_default: Standard XInput & SDL-supported controllers operate out-of-the-box.
controls.remap_section_desc: Reassign logical game actions to different controller buttons. Changes reach the native C runtime.
controls.btn_capturing: Press any button on controller… (Esc to cancel)
controls.analog_notice_desc: Analog stick movement (walking, camera) and triggers (L2/R2) operate on continuous hardware axes with variable pressure, not discrete digital buttons. To calibrate them, use 'Map Device' above.
controls.reset_confirm_msg: Reset all game button remappings back to default layout?
controls.save_success: Controller remappings saved. Changes take effect on next game launch.
controls.swapped_notice: Swapped '{old_action}' with '{new_action}' to prevent duplicate inputs.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure launcher language, graphics resolution, frame rate, and audio diagnostics.
settings.language_desc: Changes take effect immediately across all launcher pages.
diagnostics.title: Logs & System Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Inspect runtime logs, image preparation logs, and environment details for troubleshooting.
diagnostics.no_log_yet: No log file found. Launch the game first to generate logs.
